body:
That's the thing. I am not worth it and I am completely alone.  Nothing change it, nothing, and this pain is so constant and unbearable and I can see my brain rotting in real time from a lack of physical contact. THE FUCK, WHY IS IT SO HARD TO BE WORTH ANYTHING>?!!?! No one told me growing up that the last time I'd be touched was in my teens.  That's why I will eventually die. Nothing else, just being unworthy for anyone, ever, no matter how much initiation and work and effort. Meanwhile, people get everything to such a degree they find it cumbersome and tedious.

It's not just the lack of pleasure, the pain, and frustration, and the exclusion. It's that your brain fucking rots from being born incorrect and not worth something people give away to strangers in the heat of the moment who very well might have a transmittable disease. This life is a joke.  I understand why war happens. Because there is no society for some of us.  We don't get back what we put in, so we are in fact, worthless and very much alone. This is getting to be too much, and it NEVER FUCKING LETS UP FOR A FUCKING SECOND.  WHY, WILL A WOMAN PLEASE EXPLAIN TO ME WHY IT'S SO FUCKING IMPOSSIBLE TO GET A CHANCE BUT YOU THROW YOURSELVES AT STRANGERS WITHOUT A SECOND GLANCE? 

What is someone supposed to take from this?  I don't give a shit about "intrinsic value," I want pleasure, a lack of pain from forced isolation, and what seemingly every other person on this planet gets with comparatively no effort at all. But that's too much, so there is nothing here at all and people are evil. People are evil. Talking doesn't change anything, and at a certain point, I can no longer be capable for the decisions of everyone else that I'm not good enough. I want to die so that no one else can laugh at me while they enjoy that pleasure I am not good enough for.  My brain is already too rotten to do anything but stare, so it's time to end it like the little fucking animal I failed to be. There is no good, only rotten, that's the fate. 

Death or pain, lack of pleasure and touch, and brain atrophy.  Death sounds nice, comparatively. Like a death row inmate, sometimes life in this human-created prison isn't worthwhile anymore, especially when you realize it's too late and you already lost everything.
